title: Charlie Red Star sighting at Carman, Manitoba

tellings.quote: So, we turned the car to go back in and boom, it appeared from the left to the right.

plain: In 1975, near the town of Carman in Manitoba, Canada, the light known locally as Charlie Red Star suddenly appeared in front of a car full of watchers. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says he was there: they had turned the car to go back in, and "boom, it appeared from the left to the right." He tells it as his own sighting of the light that people in the area were reporting.
